description: Verify that the SD Unicast Flag of the notification is 1
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: SD Unicast Flag must equal 1. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's SD Unicast Flag == 1   ← key check

[Pass condition]
SD Unicast Flag on the wire equals 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_unicast_flag — Unicast flag not set
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
